# Support

Styr is an experimental firmware modernization project, not a commercial support product.

Use GitHub issues for reproducible bugs and concrete feature proposals. Include the firmware/build revision, relevant track type or subsystem, reproduction steps and logs where applicable. General hardware assembly or original PER|FORMER usage questions may be better served by the existing PER|FORMER community resources unless they are specific to Styr.

Security vulnerabilities must follow `SECURITY.md` rather than a public issue.
